items.prompt: Which word is spelled correctly?
items.reteach: Ejaan yang tepat: b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l.

items.prompt: Choose the correct spelling of the day after Tuesday.
items.reteach: Wednesday dibaca "wenzdei", tetapi ditulis W-e-d-n-e-s-d-a-y.

items.prompt: Which word for "sekolah" is spelled correctly?
items.reteach: School: s-c-h-o-o-l.

items.prompt: Choose the correctly spelled fruit.
items.reteach: Banana: b-a-n-a-n-a, satu n di setiap suku kata.

items.prompt: Which school thing is spelled correctly?
items.reteach: Scissors: s-c-i-s-s-o-r-s.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "I put my book on the tabel."
items.reteach: Meja dalam English ditulis table, bukan tabel.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "My techer is very kind."
items.reteach: Guru ditulis teacher: t-e-a-c-h-e-r.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "We bought fresh fish at the markit."
items.reteach: Pasar ditulis market.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Close the windou, please."
items.reteach: Jendela ditulis window.

items.prompt: Choose the correctly spelled month.
items.reteach: February: F-e-b-r-u-a-r-y. Jangan lupa huruf r setelah b.

items.prompt: Which job word is spelled correctly?
items.reteach: Doctor berakhiran -or: d-o-c-t-o-r.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Please bring an umbrela tomorrow."
items.reteach: Payung ditulis umbrella, dengan dua huruf l.

items.prompt: Read the canteen notice. What is the cheapest thing on the menu?

stimulus.text:
SCHOOL CANTEEN
Open: 07.00 – 12.00
Fried rice Rp8.000
Chicken soup Rp10.000
Ice tea Rp3.000
Please queue and keep the canteen clean.

items.reteach: Ice tea hanya Rp3.000, paling murah (cheapest). Mineral water tidak ada di menu.

items.prompt: Read the canteen notice. The word "queue" means …

stimulus.text:
SCHOOL CANTEEN
Open: 07.00 – 12.00
Fried rice Rp8.000
Chicken soup Rp10.000
Ice tea Rp3.000
Please queue and keep the canteen clean.

items.reteach: Queue = antre, berdiri berbaris.

items.prompt: Read the canteen notice. When does the canteen close?

stimulus.text:
SCHOOL CANTEEN
Open: 07.00 – 12.00
Fried rice Rp8.000
Chicken soup Rp10.000
Ice tea Rp3.000
Please queue and keep the canteen clean.

items.reteach: Open: 07.00 – 12.00, jadi kantin tutup pukul 12.00.

items.prompt: Read the text about Rani. Who carries the basket?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Rani goes to the traditional market with her mother. They buy fresh vegetables, tofu, and fish. Rani carries the basket. The sellers are friendly.

items.reteach: "Rani carries the basket." Jadi Rani yang membawa keranjang.

items.prompt: Read the text about Rani. The word "fresh" in the text means …

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Rani goes to the traditional market with her mother. They buy fresh vegetables, tofu, and fish. Rani carries the basket. The sellers are friendly.

items.reteach: Fresh vegetables = sayuran segar, baru dipetik.

items.prompt: Read the text about Rani. What do they NOT buy?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Rani goes to the traditional market with her mother. They buy fresh vegetables, tofu, and fish. Rani carries the basket. The sellers are friendly.

items.reteach: Mereka membeli vegetables, tofu, dan fish. Shoes tidak disebut.

items.prompt: Look at the table. When does Dimas have an English class?
items.reteach: Di tabel, English ada pada Tuesday.

items.prompt: Look at the table. On Thursday, Dimas probably …
items.reteach: Thursday = Art (seni), jadi Dimas menggambar dan melukis.

items.prompt: Look at the table. Which subject comes after Science?
items.reteach: Science hari Wednesday, sesudahnya Thursday: Art.

items.prompt: Read the library rules. Which is NOT allowed in the library?

stimulus.text:
LIBRARY RULES
1. Be quiet.
2. Do not eat or drink.
3. Return books in seven days.

items.reteach: Aturan 2: Do not eat or drink. Jadi makan camilan tidak boleh.

items.prompt: Read the library rules. "Return" means …

stimulus.text:
LIBRARY RULES
1. Be quiet.
2. Do not eat or drink.
3. Return books in seven days.

items.reteach: Return books = mengembalikan buku.

items.prompt: Read the library rules. Students must return books within …

stimulus.text:
LIBRARY RULES
1. Be quiet.
2. Do not eat or drink.
3. Return books in seven days.

items.reteach: Seven days = one week (satu minggu).

items.prompt:
Seller: "Good morning. Can I help you?"
Buyer: "Yes. I want a kilo of ___, the red ones."
items.reteach: Yang berwarna merah dan dijual per kilo adalah tomatoes.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Please take out your ___. We will draw straight lines."
items.reteach: Untuk menggaris lurus kita memakai ruler (penggaris).

items.prompt:
Dina: "I have a bad headache."
Mother: "Let's go to the ___."
items.reteach: Sakit kepala, jadi pergi ke dokter: go to the doctor.

items.prompt:
Seller: "These mangoes are fifty thousand rupiah a kilo."
Buyer: "That's too ___. Can I get a discount?"
items.reteach: Minta diskon karena terlalu mahal: too expensive.

items.prompt:
Andi: "Where is my pencil?"
Rudi: "It's in your pencil ___."
items.reteach: Pencil case = kotak pensil.

items.prompt:
Tourist in Surabaya: "Excuse me, where can I buy a train ticket?"
Officer: "At the ___ over there."
items.reteach: Tiket dibeli di ticket counter (loket).

items.prompt:
Bayu: "It's very hot and sunny today."
Mom: "Wear your ___ to protect your head."
items.reteach: Hat (topi) melindungi kepala dari panas.

items.prompt:
Siti: "What do you need for the art class?"
Ani: "I need paper, glue, and a pair of ___."
items.reteach: Untuk prakarya: paper, glue, scissors.

items.prompt:
Buyer at Pasar Besar Malang: "How much are the apples?"
Seller: "___"
items.reteach: How much menanyakan harga, jadi jawabannya harga.

items.prompt:
Teacher: "Who is absent today?"
Student: "___"
items.reteach: Absent = tidak hadir. Jawabannya nama yang tidak hadir.

items.prompt:
Librarian: "You can borrow three books."
Nina: "How long can I ___ them?"
Librarian: "For one week."
items.reteach: Keep = menyimpan/meminjam dalam waktu tertentu.

items.prompt:
Waiter: "What would you like to drink?"
Customer: "___"

visual.text: A glass of orange juice, please.

choices.say: A glass of orange juice, please.

visual.text: A plate of fried rice, please.

choices.say: A plate of fried rice, please.

items.reteach: Ditanya minuman, jawabannya minuman: a glass of orange juice.

items.prompt: Arrange: market / to / the / we / go / Sunday / on

visual.text: We go to the market on Sunday.

choices.say: We go to the market on Sunday.

visual.text: The market go we to on Sunday.

choices.say: The market go we to on Sunday.

visual.text: We to go the market on Sunday.

choices.say: We to go the market on Sunday.

visual.text: On we go the Sunday to market.

choices.say: On we go the Sunday to market.

items.reteach: Pola: subjek (We) + kata kerja (go) + tempat + waktu.

items.prompt: Arrange: is / my / ruler / this / new
items.reteach: Kata sifat (new) diletakkan sebelum kata benda (ruler).

items.prompt: Make it plural: "This is a box."
items.reteach: This is menjadi These are; box mendapat -es: boxes.

items.prompt: Arrange the letters to make a school thing: R – E – S – A – E – R
items.reteach: E-R-A-S-E-R = eraser, penghapus.

items.prompt: Arrange the letters to make a market word: T – I – R – U – F
items.reteach: F-R-U-I-T = fruit, buah.

items.prompt: Change "one tomato" into "three ___".
items.reteach: Tomato dan potato mendapat -es: tomatoes, potatoes.

items.prompt: Arrange: does / a / sell / what / baker
items.reteach: Pertanyaan: What + does + subjek + kata kerja?

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "There is a clock in my classroom."

visual.text: There is not a clock in my classroom.

choices.say: There is not a clock in my classroom.

visual.text: There not is a clock in my classroom.

choices.say: There not is a clock in my classroom.

visual.text: There does not a clock in my classroom.

choices.say: There does not a clock in my classroom.

visual.text: There is a not clock in my classroom.

choices.say: There is a not clock in my classroom.

items.reteach: Kalimat negatif: is + not.

items.prompt: Arrange: library / quiet / the / in / be
items.reteach: Kalimat perintah diawali kata kerja: Be quiet …

items.prompt: Change into a question: "The fish is fresh."
items.reteach: Kalimat dengan is: pindahkan is ke depan.

items.prompt: Arrange: a / my / is / farmer / uncle
items.reteach: Subjek (My uncle) + is + a farmer.

items.prompt: Make it plural: "The child has a toy."
items.reteach: Child menjadi children (tanpa s), has menjadi have.

items.prompt: Riddle: I have pages and a cover. You can find me in the library. What am I?
items.reteach: Yang punya halaman (pages) dan sampul (cover) adalah buku.

items.prompt: Which word does not belong: pilot, doctor, nurse, hospital?
items.reteach: Pilot, doctor, nurse adalah pekerjaan; hospital adalah tempat.

items.prompt: Analogy: pen is to write as scissors is to …
items.reteach: Pen untuk menulis, scissors untuk memotong (cut).

items.prompt: Code: A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, … Which word is 2-1-7?
items.reteach: 2 = B, 1 = A, 7 = G, jadi BAG.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am yellow and long. Monkeys love me. You can buy me at the fruit stall. What am I?
items.reteach: Kuning, panjang, disukai monyet: banana.

items.prompt: Which word can come before "room" to make a place at school? ___room
items.reteach: Classroom = ruang kelas. Bedroom dan living room ada di rumah.

items.prompt: Take away the first letter of a word to get a new word: seat → eat. Which word can do this too?
items.reteach: plate tanpa huruf p menjadi late (terlambat). Kata lain tidak menjadi kata baru.

items.prompt: Analogy: teacher → school, doctor → …
items.reteach: Guru bekerja di sekolah, dokter bekerja di rumah sakit.

items.prompt: Which word has the most letters?
items.reteach: Vegetable punya 9 huruf; yang lain 6 huruf.

items.prompt: Unscramble the letters to find a job: R – E – M – A – F – R
items.reteach: F-A-R-M-E-R = farmer, petani.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a day. I come after Friday and before Sunday. What day am I?
items.reteach: Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

items.prompt: Put these words in ABC order: desk, bag, apple, canteen. Which word is third?
items.reteach: Urutan abjad: apple, bag, canteen, desk. Yang ketiga canteen.
